description: Worst-case compressed size of an n-byte input (ZSTD_COMPRESSBOUND), 0 when n exceeds the maximum input size
notes: zstd 1.5.6, ZSTD_COMPRESSBOUND macro (lib/zstd.h), the formula behind ZSTD_compressBound, with a 64-bit size_t (ZSTD_MAX_INPUT_SIZE = 0xFF00FF00FF00FF00). Written by us from the macro. clang trunk -O3 -march=skylake keeps a branch for the size limit, then a shift, a select for the small-input margin ((128 KiB - n) >> 11) and two adds: 12 IR instructions. Whether a shorter form exists is unknown.
